videos.headline: Jordan Travis and Preston Daniel connect for 1st FSU TD
videos.description: Preston Daniel hauls in the dime from Jordan Travis to put the Seminoles on the board first.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Jordan Travis and Preston Daniel connect for 1st FSU TD) 2022/09/16 ESHEET

videos.headline: Malik Cunningham shakes a few defenders and finds pay dirt for Louisville
videos.description: Malik Cunningham puts a few defenders on skates and crosses the goal line to tie the score at 7-7.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Malik Cunningham shakes a few defenders and finds pay dirt for Louisville) 2022/09/16 ESHEET

videos.headline: Trevion Cooley takes the HB screen to the crib for Louisville
videos.description: Trevion Cooley maneuvers through the Seminoles' defense and plows into the end zone to give the Cardinals the lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Trevion Cooley takes the HB screen to the crib for Louisville) 2022/09/16 ESHEET

videos.headline: FSU WR Malik McClain makes an incredible grab to tie the score

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (FSU WR Malik McClain makes an incredible grab to tie the score) 2022/09/16 ESHEET

videos.headline: Derrick McLendon II recovers the fumble for FSU
